T: A pig who herds sheep. Strictly no pork tonight.
D: A piglet raised by sheepdogs learns to herd sheep.
P: Serve dessert when Babe steps out to herd at the sheepdog trials.
S: Egg mayo with chives on soft white bread, cut in triangles

Egg and lettuce sandwiches on soft white bread, eggs boiled 10 minutes, mashed with mayo, chives and white pepper. Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Mash with 3 tbsp mayo, chives and white pepper. Spread on 8 slices soft white bread with shredded iceberg, close and cut into triangles.
Pecorino, sheep's feta and ricotta with fresh figs and honey
Ewe's milk cheese (pecorino), sheep's feta and fresh ricotta on a board with honey, figs and crackers.
Ferdinand the duck, sneaking round the vegie patch

Crisp baby carrots, radish, cucumber, snow peas and cherry tomatoes with a bright green goddess dip of herbs, sour cream and lemon. Blitz 150g sour cream, 80g mayonnaise, a handful each of parsley, basil and chives, 1 spring onion, the juice of half a lemon and salt until smooth and green. Chill 30 minutes. Trim 1 bunch baby carrots and 1 bunch radishes, cut 1 Lebanese cucumber into sticks and top 150g snow peas. Arrange around the dip with 250g cherry tomatoes.
M: Farmhouse leek, mushroom and cheddar pie
potato and leek in cheesy thyme sauce under golden puff, that'll do

Leek, mushroom and potato in a creamy cheddar and thyme sauce under a golden puff pastry lid, with buttered peas on the side. Boil 500g diced potato for 8 minutes and drain. Cook 2 sliced leeks and 300g sliced mushrooms in 40g butter for 10 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then 400ml milk and simmer 3 minutes. Add 150g grated cheddar, thyme, the potato, salt and pepper. Pour into a pie dish, cover with 2 sheets puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Serve with 400g buttered peas.
Beef mince in tomato gravy under baked mashed potato
Beef mince browned hard, onion and carrot softened, tomato paste, Worcestershire and stock, simmered 40 minutes, topped with buttery mash, forked and baked at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
W: Stewed cinnamon apples under a butter crumble, with custard

Apples stewed with sugar and cinnamon, crumble of flour, butter, oats and brown sugar, baked at 180C for 35 minutes. Stew 6 sliced apples with 60g sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 10 minutes and tip into a dish. Rub 100g butter into 100g flour, then stir in 60g oats and 80g brown sugar. Scatter over and bake at 180C for 35 minutes. Serve with custard.
K: Vanilla ice cream and malt blended thick, topped with whipped cream

Cold full cream milk blended thick with vanilla ice cream, malt powder and a drizzle of honey, topped with whipped cream in tall glasses. Put 600ml cold full cream milk, 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tbsp honey in a blender. Blend 30 seconds until thick and frothy. Pour into 4 chilled tall glasses. Whip 150ml thickened cream to soft peaks and spoon on top, then dust with a pinch of malt powder.

s.note: Mrs Hoggett's baking, Ferdinand at the window.

steps.text: Boil the eggs hard, then cool in cold water and peel.
Mash the eggs with the mayonnaise, chopped chives and white pepper.
Spread on the bread with shredded lettuce, close up and cut into triangles.
Take the cheeses out of the fridge an hour ahead so they lose the chill.
Halve the figs, then arrange the pecorino, sheep's feta and fresh ricotta on a board with the figs, drizzle over the honey and put the crackers alongside.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, assemble then bake

steps.text: Dice the onion and carrots. Peel the potatoes and cut into chunks.
Brown the mince hard in a large pan, then add the onion and carrot and cook a few minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce and stock and simmer until thick, then season with salt and pepper.
Boil the potatoes until soft, drain and mash with the butter.
Spoon the mince into a baking dish, top with mash and fork the surface. Bake at 200C until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, assemble then bake

steps.text: Dice the onion and carrots and chop the mushrooms. Peel the potatoes and cut into chunks.
Brown the mushrooms hard in the oil in a large pan, then add the onion and carrot and cook a few minutes.
Stir in the lentils, tomato paste, soy sauce and stock and simmer until thick. Season with salt and pepper.
Boil the potatoes until soft, drain and mash with the butter.
Spoon the lentil mix into a baking dish, top with mash and fork the surface. Bake at 200C until golden.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake fresh to serve warm

steps.text: Peel, core and slice the apples.
Stew the apples with the caster sugar and cinnamon until just soft, then tip into a baking dish.
Rub the cold butter into the flour, then stir in the oats and brown sugar. Scatter over the apples.
Bake at 180C until golden and bubbling. Heat the custard and serve alongside.

dishes.make_ahead: Whip the cream up to 4 hours ahead and keep it chilled with the glasses; blend just before serving

ingredients.item: malted milk powder, for the shake

steps.text: Chill four tall glasses. Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Blend the milk, ice cream, the malted milk powder for the shake and the honey until thick and frothy.
Pour into the glasses, spoon the cream on top and dust with the extra malted milk powder.
